verdict_text:
NO

The script drops head 6 (`DROP_HEAD = 6`), but the specification requires removing head 5 in clause "Required result: For every layer `i`, remove head 5". The resulting kept-column ranges therefore differ from the spec: the artifact keeps columns `0..383, 448..2303` (dropping `384..447`), whereas the spec requires keeping `0..319, 384..767, 768..1087, 1152..1535, 1536..1855, 1920..2303` (dropping `320..383`), and analogously for `c_attn.bias` and `c_proj.weight`. The shape assertions (768,2112 / 2112 / 704,768) pass since only which head is dropped differs, not the resulting size, but the values will not be bit-exact against the hidden reference, violating the Grading clause's exact-values requirement and the "remove head 5" requirement.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
